intro: Laos is a mountainous, forested, landlocked country with the Mekong River along its western side.

chapters.title: Mountains and the Mekong
text: About three-quarters of Laos is mountains and plateaus; Phou Bia, 2,818 m, is the highest peak. The Mekong forms much of the border with Thailand, and in the south it spreads into Si Phan Don, 'four thousand islands'.
The Plain of Jars is covered with hundreds of ancient stone jars whose purpose is still debated.

chapters.title: Climate
text: Laos is tropical, with a rainy season from May to October.
